limits: First hosted build passed; performance collection failed on a baseline small-viewport fixture. Required protection correctly reports the draft blocked; a valid full hosted performance comparison is not established by that failed run.

Requiring a check name does not prevent candidate workflow edits from changing what that check executes. Review enforcement-control changes explicitly; this records accidental-regression gates, not tamper-proof CI certification.

bootstrap.scope: Only the initial exact legacy base lacking maintained controls; candidate tooling measures both trees under the workflow explicit bootstrap warning.
bootstrap.retire: Remove after the first harness-bearing main merge; subsequent bases use base-owned tooling.
